summary: The CostTypeLookups document provides web services for retrieving cost type categories and codes using AJAX Toolkit cascading dropdowns.
purpose: To enable AJAX Toolkit cascading dropdowns with cost type categories and descriptions in web applications.

entities.name: CostTypeLookups
entities.description: Web service for cost type lookup operations

methods.name: GetCostTypes
methods.description: Retrieves cost type categories for dropdowns

methods.name: GetCostTypeCode
methods.description: Retrieves cost type code description by category ID

fields.name: knownCategoryValues
fields.description: String containing session ID, discipline, and code category ID

fields.name: category
fields.description: String containing session hash and discipline

fields.name: contextKey
fields.description: String context key for determining dropdown selection

workflows.name: Cost Type Retrieval
steps: Parse knownCategoryValues for session ID and code category ID.
Generate list of cascading dropdown values based on code category ID.
